prompt: Which statements about repository roles in an organization are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: The ladder read → triage → write → maintain → admin stacks capabilities cleanly. Read is view-only and merges nothing — and pushing a branch needs just write, not admin.

options.text: Triage can manage labels and close issues without pushing code
Write can push branches and merge pull requests
Admin controls repository settings and access
Read can merge pull requests into protected branches
Admin access is required before anyone can push a branch
